# Audit Report — pi-goal-list-loop-audit (`audit-mu0xpj79-35tun1`)

**Scope:** Backfade v0.1 complete loop (contracts / compiler API / web) per goal `20260914065800-fmqoho.md`.

## Summary of findings

Contract items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 were **re-verified live by me** and pass. Item 5 passes its letter (build + no react/wagmi/vue) **but the objective's explicit "Tailwind" stack requirement is unmet**, and fresh screenshots expose a shipped visual defect: the app's `styles.css` begins with a JS-style `//` comment, which per CSS error recovery causes the browser to discard the entire following `:root{...}` design-token block. Every built page therefore renders with white background, black serif fallback text, and an invisible conviction bar — contradicting the stylesheet's own stated intent ("dark only, brand green"). I reproduced this exact failure mode in isolation with a minimal HTML file (header dark / body white / `--canvas` undefined). The executor's summary claims a working UI; the built UI is visibly broken.

- Fix `web/src/styles.css` line 1: replace the JS-style `// Backfade v0.1 …` comment with a CSS comment `/* … */`; verify `:root` tokens apply and pages render dark with the conviction bar visible.
